review.editorial_summary: Completed the C++ LAS implementation; unchanged source passes 219/223 under LAS 2.0.4. Remaining gaps: absent-waveform validation.
review.notes:
Completed the C++20 codec, all-format round trips, metadata/corruption checks and an ASan/UBSan self-test; recovered from an early out-of-order sanitizer invocation and rejected patch before voluntarily finishing. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 219/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 184/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  Remaining source defects: A waveform descriptor/storage mode is required from the point format before recognizing descriptor index 0 as no associated waveform. This one implementation defect is observed in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. The exact tool-call total is unavailable because preserved failed-wrapper evidence is ambiguous; tool_calls and tool_calls_definition are null. The original canonical baseline 81 remains only in the audit, not an exact-count claim. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool-call total is unavailable because failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact count; the prior canonical baseline is retained only in the audit. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed C++20 LAS codec with successful final builds and extensive self-tests; incomplete on all-zero waveform records.
payload.notes: Reviewed the complete preserved event sequence and final completion message. The model implemented a C++20 JSON codec, exercised all eleven point formats, structured metadata, round trips, eight corruption cases and an ASan/UBSan self-test. An early sanitizer invocation preceded its build and failed, then the build and sanitizer run completed successfully. One rejected patch was recovered; neither incident ended the run. Original LAS 2.0.1 score 184/219 contained 31 fixture/representation failures. The unchanged submission scores 219/223 under 2.0.2: corrected EVLR-header-relative offsets and classification-table representation remove those failures, and all four new waveform-range controls pass. The only four remaining failures are valid all-zero waveform blocks in formats 4,5,9,10: las.cpp lines 805-806 unconditionally requires internal/external waveform mode and a descriptor table based on point format, although descriptor index 0 means no associated waveform. This is one model validation defect observed in four layouts. CLI 0.153.4 completed voluntarily; grading completed without skips/errors; full usage reparses identically (8,222,517 input+88,120 output;8,028,416 cached;36,552 reasoning included in output;81 underlying tool calls). Estimated generation cost $5.750170, not provider-reported. Both original and corrected grades, source, transcript, sessions and network evidence are preserved. The final LAS 2.0.3 regrade also scores 219/223 with identical per-test outcomes to 2.0.2. Its Extra Bytes mismatch fixture now supplies an explicit one-byte tail against a two-byte descriptor, eliminating the unspecified omitted-tail default. Both Sol implementations reject this actual mismatch; the same four all-zero waveform model failures remain. All original generation evidence and the earlier regrade are preserved.
failure_clusters: All-zero waveform blocks with descriptor_index0 rejected in point formats4,5,9,10; storage mode and descriptor table incorrectly required for the whole format.
